sloka: प्रसीद शिरसा याचे भूमौ निततिता अस्मि ते ।याचिता अस्मि हता देव हन्तव्या अहम् न हि त्वया ॥२-६२-१२॥
transliteration: prasīda śirasā yāce bhūmau nitatitā asmi te ।yācitā asmi hatā deva hantavyā aham na hi tvayā ॥2-62-12॥

translations.english: O lord, by falling on the ground at your feet, bowing my head I beg of you to be pleased. By your act of beseeching me, I have been badly hurt. I do deserve to be pardoned.
